@app_name.description: The name of the app, wherever it names itself.

@liveedit_copy.description: The button of a code block that copies its text.

@liveedit_copied.description: What the copy button of a code block says just after copying.

@shell_file_menu.description: The File menu: under the mark in the title bar on Windows and Linux, in the menu bar on macOS.

@shell_open_hint.description: What the box in the title bar says it does.

@shell_save_as.description: Saves the document to a file the user picks.

@shell_close.description: Closes a tab or the window.

@shell_toggle_theme.description: The button that flips the theme.

@shell_view_live.description: The view that renders Markdown as you type.

@shell_view_source.description: The view of the plain Markdown text.

@shell_view_focus.description: The view menu's label in focus mode.

@shell_view_typewriter.description: The view menu's label in typewriter mode.

@shell_open_documents.description: The heading of the sidebar list.

@shell_saved.description: The status of a document with nothing to save.

@shell_saving.description: The status while writing to disk.

@shell_unsaved.description: The status of a document with changes not on disk.

@shell_conflict.description: The file changed on disk, so saving stopped.

@shell_save_failed.description: The status after a failed save.

shell_welcome: Open a file and start writing

@shell_welcome.description: The line under the name on the welcome page.

shell_too_large: This file is over 5 MB and cannot be opened yet

@shell_too_large.description: A notice when a file is too large.

@shell_not_found.description: A notice when a file is gone.

@shell_failed.description: A notice for any other failure.

@shell_confirm_title.description: Asked when closing a document with unsaved changes.

@shell_markdown_files.description: The file type in file dialogs.

@shell_words.description: The number of words in the document.

@shell_capsule_detail.description: The status capsule, hovered: the reading time in minutes and the caret's block of all blocks.

@shell_reopen_closed.description: Opens the tab closed last again.

@shell_next_tab.description: Activates the tab to the right, wrapping around.

@shell_prev_tab.description: Activates the tab to the left, wrapping around.

@shell_go_to_tab.description: Activates the tab at a position, counted from 1.

@shell_strong.description: Makes the selection bold, or removes bold.

@shell_emphasis.description: Makes the selection italic, or removes italic.

@shell_underline.description: Underlines the selection, or removes the underline.

@shell_strike.description: Strikes through the selection, or removes it.

@shell_inline_code.description: Marks the selection as inline code.

@shell_link.description: Turns the selection into a link.

@shell_paragraph.description: Turns the block into a plain paragraph.

@shell_quote.description: Turns the block into a quote, or back.

@shell_bullet_list.description: Turns the block into a bulleted list item.

@shell_ordered_list.description: Turns the block into a numbered list item.

@shell_task_list.description: Turns the block into a task list item.

@shell_toggle_task.description: Checks or unchecks the task at the caret.

@shell_code_block.description: Turns the block into a code block.

@shell_indent.description: Indents the list item or block.

@shell_outdent.description: Outdents the list item or block.

@shell_move_up.description: Moves the block above the previous one.

@shell_move_down.description: Moves the block below the next one.

@shell_row_above.description: Inserts a table row above the caret's.

@shell_row_below.description: Inserts a table row below the caret's.

@shell_col_left.description: Inserts a table column left of the caret's.

@shell_col_right.description: Inserts a table column right of the caret's.

@shell_focus.description: Dims everything but the caret's block.

@shell_typewriter.description: Keeps the caret's line in the middle of the window.

@shell_reading.description: Hides the window around the document and shows it read-only in a serif face.

@shell_exit_reading.description: The button at the top right of reading mode.

@shell_zoom_reset.description: Returns the document's text to the size in Settings.

@shell_heading.description: Turns the block into a heading of a level from 1 to 6.

@shell_palette_files.description: The palette's badge and group title for files.

@shell_palette_commands.description: The palette's badge and group title for commands.

@shell_palette_headings.description: The palette's badge and group title for the document's headings.

shell_palette_placeholder: Search files, > for commands, @ for headings

@shell_palette_footer.description: The keys the palette takes, in its footer.

@shell_omnibox.description: The title bar's omnibox, which opens the palette.

@shell_go_to_heading.description: Opens the palette on the document's headings.

@shell_palette_count.description: How many rows the palette lists.

@shell_no_folder.description: The files panel without a folder.

@shell_open_folder.description: Opens a folder in the files panel.

@shell_new_file.description: Makes a file in the folder clicked.

@shell_new_folder.description: Makes a folder in the folder clicked.

@shell_rename.description: Edits a file's name in its row.

@shell_trash.description: Moves a file or folder to the trash.

shell_name_invalid: This name cannot be used here

@shell_untitled.description: The name of a new file or folder.

@shell_no_headings.description: The outline panel of a document without headings.

@shell_search_word.description: The search option matching whole words.

@shell_search_regex.description: The search option reading the query as a regular expression.

@shell_search_count.description: The count of a search's matches and files.

@shell_search_capped.description: A search stopped at its cap.

@shell_search_bad_regex.description: A query that is not a valid regular expression.

@shell_search_in_folder.description: The command showing the search panel.

shell_trash_unsaved: {name} has unsaved changes. Move it to the trash?

@shell_moved.description: After a drag moved a file or folder.

@liveedit_structure.description: The structure rail of headings at the editor's edge.

@liveedit_align_right.description: Table menu item aligning the column.

@liveedit_format_table.description: Table toolbar button and menu item reflowing the table's source.

@liveedit_link.description: The popover of the link holding the caret.

@liveedit_edit_link.description: Selects the link's destination to type over it.

@shell_copy_markdown.description: Command copying the selection as Markdown only.

@shell_copy_html.description: Command copying the selection as HTML.

@shell_paste_plain.description: Command pasting the clipboard text without converting it.

@kit_find.description: The find bar, and the placeholder of its query field.

@kit_replace_with.description: The placeholder of the find bar's replacement field.

@kit_replace_all.description: Replaces every match, as one step of undo.

@kit_bad_regex.description: The find bar's query is not a valid regular expression.

@shell_replace.description: Opens the find bar with replacing.

@shell_keep_mine.description: Writes the document over the file changed on disk.

@shell_load_theirs.description: Replaces the document with the file on disk, as a step of undo.

@shell_banner_deleted.description: The banner of a document whose file was deleted.

shell_banner_deleted_detail: The text is still here; saving creates the file again.

@shell_save_again.description: Saves a deleted document, creating its file again.

@shell_banner_read_only.description: The banner of a read-only document.

shell_banner_read_only_detail: You can read it; save a copy to change it.

@shell_banner_large.description: The banner of a document opened in large file mode.

shell_banner_large_detail: Some live rendering is off to keep it fast.

@shell_banner_large_detail.description: Under the large file banner's title.

@shell_deleted_status.description: The status capsule of a document whose file was deleted.

@shell_recent.description: Heading of the welcome page's list of recently opened files and folders.

shell_session_missing: {n} files from last time no longer exist

@shell_session_missing.description: Notice after restoring the last session: some of its files are gone.

shell_session_unreadable: Last session could not be read

@shell_export_html.description: Command: writes the document as an HTML page.

@shell_exported.description: Notice after an export finished; the file's name is shown under it.

@shell_print_preview.description: Title of the window that shows the page being printed.

@settings_open.description: The title bar button that opens settings.
